name: HY-Motion: Hold_Crouch. Maintain the single-knee kneeling crouched posture with the pistol held ready at the chest, hiding behind cover. The left hand forms a loose fist and presses against the left thigh for support, keeping the left elbow close to the torso to minimize visibility.
